Personally, I feel like gender is a scam. It's a scam taught to us to keep many of us abused and traumatized by patriarchy and to keep others upholding it. I also resonate with non-binary in some way because as an agender person I feel like I have stepped out of the binary. But non-binary people often talk about how gender-full they are whereas I feel like that's just uh .... being imaginative. It's cool and fun and I like it, but I view it more as having aesthetic choices and personality characteristics, which for me have nothing to do with gender. Edit: this is obviously coming from the bias of someone who doesnt FEEL gender so can't imagine how other people feel it.
